requirement_text: System shall allow users to select other TU/e related Twitter sites from a list upon starting the Twitter app (content of the list is defined in requirement UCAR903).
user_story: As a TU/e follower, I want to select other TU/e related Twitter sites from a list when the Twitter app starts, so that I can follow them.
technical_task: Show a list of TU/e related Twitter sites at startup of the Twitter app, with contents as defined in requirement UCAR903.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Twitter app starts, when the first screen is displayed, then a list of TU/e related Twitter sites is shown.
Given the list, when the user selects a site, then that Twitter site is chosen.
rationale: Role assumed: TU/e follower. The list content is defined in requirement UCAR903.

requirement_text: The user will follow a number of links to World Wide Web documents.
rationale: "A number of links" are not identified and no system behaviour is stated.
clarification_questions: Which links to World Wide Web documents must the user follow?
What must the system provide to support following them?

requirement_text: THEN TSA display content shall be updated to the new implicit speed limit according to TSA display strategy earliest 500 milliseconds before and no later than the EV enters the village / town.
user_story: As a driver, I want the TSA display updated to the new implicit speed limit at the earliest 500 milliseconds before and no later than when the EV enters the village or town, so that I see the right limit in time.
technical_task: Update the TSA display content to the new implicit speed limit, per the TSA display strategy, between 500 milliseconds before and the moment the EV enters the village or town.
acceptance_criteria: Given the EV approaches a village or town, when the time reaches 500 milliseconds before entry, then the TSA display may be updated to the new implicit speed limit.
Given the EV enters the village or town, when it enters, then the TSA display already shows the new implicit speed limit.
rationale: Role assumed: driver. The leading "THEN" refers to a condition not shown.

requirement_text: Upon user login, the system will display personalized information and automatically add certain details to booking requests.
user_story: As a returning user, I want personalized information shown after login and certain details added to my booking requests automatically, so that booking is quicker.
technical_task: After login, display personalized information and prefill certain details in booking requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user logs in, when login completes, then personalized information is displayed.
Given a user creates a booking request, when the form opens, then certain details are added automatically.
rationale: Role assumed: returning user. Which details are added is not stated.

requirement_text: The y-axis displays the frequent occurrence (in percent) of this level, which means the probability that the received level is equal or smaller than the x-axis value.
rationale: The sentence explains a chart axis and states no required behaviour.
clarification_questions: What diagram does the sentence describe and what must the system do?

requirement_text: The scheduler shall set the 50 Hz interval timer to a count down value so as to cause the next minor frame interrupt at 20 msec from the previous interrupt congruently in all operational FCPs.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS181] set the 50 Hz interval timer to a count down value so as to cause the next minor frame interrupt at 20 msec from the previous interrupt congruently in all operational FCPs.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the scheduler to set the 50 Hz interval timer so the next minor frame interrupt occurs 20 msec after the previous one in all operational FCPs, so that frames stay in step.
technical_task: Load the 50 Hz interval timer with a countdown value that triggers the next minor frame interrupt 20 msec after the previous interrupt, congruently in all operational FCPs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a minor frame interrupt, when the scheduler sets the 50 Hz interval timer, then the next minor frame interrupt occurs 20 msec after the previous interrupt.
Given several operational FCPs, when the timer is set, then it is set congruently in all of them.

requirement_text: Staff shall keep user bank accounts updated and consistent.
user_story: As a bank manager, I want staff to keep user bank accounts updated and consistent, so that account data is correct.
technical_task: Provide functions for staff to update user bank accounts and keep them consistent.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user bank account, when staff update it, then the changes are saved.
Given related account data, when staff update one part, then the other parts remain consistent.
rationale: Role assumed: bank manager; the requirement says staff.

requirement_text: The software shall offer an essential non-functional requirement highlighting its operation.
rationale: The sentence refers to an unnamed requirement and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: Which non-functional requirement is meant and what does "highlighting its operation" require?
Is this a requirement or a statement about the document?

requirement_text: The diameters must be appropriately chosen for the currents.
rationale: "Appropriately" is not defined and no values are given.
clarification_questions: What does "appropriately chosen" mean for the diameters?
What currents apply to which diameters?

requirement_text: When a request to turn on or off a heating or cooling unit is made, this process shall generate the appropriate request to carry out that request. This request shall include the designation of the heating or cooling unit and a flag to indicate whether that unit is to be turned on or off.
user_story: As a building manager, I want a request to turn a heating or cooling unit on or off to produce a request that names the unit and a flag for on or off, so that the right unit is switched.
technical_task: When a request to turn a heating or cooling unit on or off is made, generate a request containing the unit's designation and an on/off flag.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request to turn a heating or cooling unit on or off, when the process runs, then it generates a request to carry it out.
Given the generated request, when it is read, then it includes the designation of the unit and a flag showing whether it is to be turned on or off.

requirement_text: Upon selecting Home, system shall display videos based on user history, subscription, and search.
user_story: As a viewer, I want videos shown on Home based on my history, subscriptions and searches, so that I see relevant videos.
technical_task: Fill the Home view with videos chosen from the user's history, subscriptions and searches.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with history, subscriptions and searches, when the user selects Home, then videos based on them are displayed.
Given a user with no history, when the user selects Home, then videos are still displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: viewer. The second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: System uses MySQL (Version 5.5.8) for the database with several tables for storing information.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want the system to use MySQL Version 5.5.8 with several tables for its information, so that the database platform is known.
technical_task: Use MySQL Version 5.5.8 as the database, storing information in several tables.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system's database, when its version is checked, then it is MySQL Version 5.5.8.
Given the database, when its structure is reviewed, then information is stored in several tables.

requirement_text: User shall be able to track delivery status by providing necessary information.
user_story: As a customer, I want to track delivery status by providing the necessary information, so that I know where my order is.
technical_task: Provide a delivery tracking function that takes the required identifying information.
acceptance_criteria: Given the necessary information for an order, when the customer submits it, then the delivery status is shown.
Given incorrect information, when the customer submits it, then no delivery status is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. What the necessary information is is not stated.

requirement_text: The LHCP is presented with an option to approve or reject each pending appointment request.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to approve or reject each pending appointment request, so that my schedule is controlled.
technical_task: Offer approve and reject options for every pending appointment request.
acceptance_criteria: Given a pending appointment request, when the LHCP approves it, then the request is approved.
Given a pending appointment request, when the LHCP rejects it, then the request is rejected.

requirement_text: System shall generate reports based on selected parameters.
user_story: As a manager, I want reports generated from selected parameters, so that I get the information I need.
technical_task: Generate reports using parameters chosen by the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given selected parameters, when the user requests a report, then the report is generated from them.
Given different parameters, when the user requests the report again, then the report content changes.

requirement_text: The system shall offer options for data encryption to further enhance security.
user_story: As a user, I want options for data encryption, so that I can add protection.
technical_task: Offer data encryption as an option.
acceptance_criteria: Given the security settings, when the user looks for encryption, then data encryption options are offered.
Given an encryption option is chosen, when data is stored, then it is encrypted.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The options are not listed.

requirement_text: The MultiMahjongServer shall act as a central relay for data between MultiMahjongClients.
user_story: As a player, I want the MultiMahjongServer to relay data between MultiMahjongClients, so that players can play together.
technical_task: Make the MultiMahjongServer a central relay that passes data between MultiMahjongClients.
acceptance_criteria: Given two MultiMahjongClients connected to the server, when one sends data, then the server relays it to the other.
Given data from a MultiMahjongClient, when it arrives at the server, then it is not delivered anywhere except through the server.
rationale: Role assumed: player. The second criterion follows from "central relay".

requirement_text: The system shall support the English language.
user_story: As a user, I want the system in English, so that I can understand it.
technical_task: Support the English language in the user interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system, when it is displayed, then the text is in English.
Given the English language, when the user uses all screens, then every screen is available in English.

requirement_text: The MultiMahjongServer will support an architecture whereby all Computer Opponents (CO) required will reside on it instead of on the MultiMahjongClient programs.
user_story: As a player, I want all Computer Opponents to run on the MultiMahjongServer instead of on my client, so that my client stays light.
technical_task: Run every required Computer Opponent (CO) on the MultiMahjongServer rather than in the MultiMahjongClient programs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a game needing Computer Opponents, when it starts, then all required Computer Opponents run on the MultiMahjongServer.
Given a MultiMahjongClient, when the game runs, then no Computer Opponent runs in the client.
rationale: Role assumed: player. The benefit is inferred.

requirement_text: Crafty kids corner shall implement measures to ensure the safety and privacy of users, particularly children, by adhering to relevant regulations and guidelines regarding online data protection.
user_story: As a parent, I want measures that protect the safety and privacy of users, especially children, following online data protection rules, so that my child is safe.
technical_task: Apply safety and privacy measures to Crafty kids corner in line with the relevant online data protection regulations and guidelines.
acceptance_criteria: Given a child user, when the user's data is collected or shown, then it is handled according to the relevant data protection regulations and guidelines.
Given the site, when it is reviewed, then measures for the safety and privacy of users, particularly children, are in place.
rationale: Role assumed: parent. The regulations are not named.

requirement_text: The system shall offer built-in analytics to track marketing activities, user sessions, engagement metrics, and campaign performance.
user_story: As a marketing manager, I want built-in analytics for marketing activities, user sessions, engagement metrics and campaign performance, so that I can see what works.
technical_task: Add analytics that track marketing activities, user sessions, engagement metrics and campaign performance.
acceptance_criteria: Given marketing activities and campaigns, when they run, then the analytics track their activity and performance.
Given user sessions, when users use the system, then the analytics record the sessions and engagement metrics.

requirement_text: The system shall allow visitors to post comments on articles.
user_story: As a visitor, I want to post comments on articles, so that I can share my opinion.
technical_task: Allow visitors to post comments on articles.
acceptance_criteria: Given an article, when a visitor posts a comment, then the comment is saved with the article.
Given an article with comments, when it is viewed, then the comments are shown.

requirement_text: The system shall ensure continuous availability, allowing users to control and monitor devices 24/7 without interruptions.
user_story: As a user, I want to control and monitor devices at any time, 24/7, without interruption, so that I can rely on the system.
technical_task: Keep the system available around the clock so that users can control and monitor devices.
acceptance_criteria: Given any time of day, when a user controls or monitors a device, then the system is available.
Given the system in operation, when it is used over 24/7, then it runs without interruption.

requirement_text: The system shall validate the specified information during the registration process.
user_story: As a new user, I want my information validated during registration, so that mistakes are caught.
technical_task: Validate the specified information when a user registers.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid information, when the user registers, then registration succeeds.
Given invalid information, when the user registers, then registration is rejected.
rationale: Role assumed: new user. The specified information is not listed.

requirement_text: The software shall run on Linux or Windows OS.
user_story: As a user, I want the software to run on Linux or Windows, so that I can use my operating system.
technical_task: Support Linux and Windows operating systems.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Linux computer, when the software is installed, then it runs.
Given a Windows computer, when the software is installed, then it runs.

requirement_text: The automated diagnostic tool shall input sensed data in real time from data acquisition devices and the HVAC unit under diagnosis as well as from data files containing previously acquired data, though not simultaneously.
user_story: As an HVAC technician, I want the diagnostic tool to take sensed data in real time from data acquisition devices and the HVAC unit, or from files of earlier data, but not both at once, so that I can analyze live or stored data.
technical_task: Input sensed data in real time from data acquisition devices and the HVAC unit under diagnosis, or from data files with previously acquired data, without using both simultaneously.
acceptance_criteria: Given data acquisition devices and the HVAC unit under diagnosis, when the tool is used live, then it inputs sensed data in real time.
Given a data file with previously acquired data, when the tool is used with it, then live and file input are not used at the same time.

requirement_text: The system shall offer a logout option for customers after shopping or browsing.
user_story: As a customer, I want to log out after shopping or browsing, so that my session ends.
technical_task: Offer a logout option for customers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a logged-in customer, when the customer chooses logout, then the session is ended.
Given a logged-out customer, when the customer tries to continue, then login is required.

requirement_text: An LHCP views a list of his or her upcoming appointments for the current date (sorted by time soonest upcoming first) with each appointment displayed in the format 'HH:MM AM or PM - AppointmentType'.
requirement_text_raw: An LHCP views a list of his or her upcoming appointments for the current date (sorted by time  soonest upcoming first)  with each appointment displayed in the format 'HH:MM AM or PM - AppointmentType'.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to see my upcoming appointments for today sorted by the soonest time first in the format HH:MM AM or PM - AppointmentType, so that I know my day.
technical_task: List the LHCP's appointments for the current date, soonest first, each displayed as 'HH:MM AM or PM - AppointmentType'.
acceptance_criteria: Given appointments for the current date, when the LHCP opens the list, then they are sorted by time with the soonest upcoming first.
Given an appointment in the list, when it is displayed, then it uses the format 'HH:MM AM or PM - AppointmentType'.

requirement_text: Pressing the panic button of the key for T greater than or equal to 1 second will start the panic alarm, shortly pressing the button (T less than 1 second) stops the alarm.
user_story: As a vehicle owner, I want pressing the panic button for 1 second or more to start the alarm and a short press to stop it, so that I can control the alarm.
technical_task: Start the panic alarm when the button is pressed for T greater than or equal to 1 second and stop it on a short press (T less than 1 second).
acceptance_criteria: Given the panic button of the key, when it is pressed for T greater than or equal to 1 second, then the panic alarm starts.
Given the panic alarm is on, when the button is pressed shortly (T less than 1 second), then the alarm stops.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to search for restaurants on the mobile application using various options including price, destination, restaurant type, specific dish, and free text with the ability to combine multiple options in a single search.
user_story: As a diner, I want to search for restaurants on the mobile application by price, destination, restaurant type, specific dish and free text, and combine these options, so that I can narrow my search.
technical_task: Implement a restaurant search on the mobile application with price, destination, restaurant type, specific dish and free text options that can be combined in one search.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search option such as price, destination, restaurant type, specific dish or free text, when the user searches, then matching restaurants are shown.
Given several search options combined, when the user searches, then the results match all of the chosen options.
rationale: Role assumed: diner. "Including" means other options may exist.

requirement_text: A Lab Technician can view his or her assigned lab procedures.
user_story: As a lab technician, I want to view my assigned lab procedures, so that I know my work.
technical_task: Show a Lab Technician the lab procedures assigned to them.
acceptance_criteria: Given lab procedures assigned to a Lab Technician, when the technician opens the list, then they are shown.
Given lab procedures assigned to another technician, when the technician opens the list, then they are not shown.

requirement_text: The contractor shall document the root causes for all occurring software errors and details about the removal of the error in the error tracking system (DANTE).
user_story: As a client, I want the contractor to document the root causes of all software errors and how they were removed in the error tracking system, so that fixes can be traced.
technical_task: Record in the error tracking system (DANTE) the root cause of every software error and details of how it was removed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a software error that occurs, when it is handled, then its root cause is documented in the error tracking system (DANTE).
Given a removed software error, when its entry is read, then it contains details of how the error was removed.

requirement_text: System shall be able to handle and support the total number of students enrolled in CSUN.
user_story: As a university administrator, I want the system to support the total number of students enrolled in CSUN, so that all students can use it.
technical_task: Size the system for the total number of students enrolled in CSUN.
acceptance_criteria: Given all students enrolled in CSUN, when they use the system, then it handles and supports them.
Given growth in enrollment, when the total number of students changes, then the system still supports the total enrolled.
rationale: Role assumed: university administrator. The student count is not given.

requirement_text: The solution should not allow deletions or alteration of the contents of the audit log.
user_story: As an auditor, I want the audit log not to allow deletion or alteration of its contents, so that it can be trusted.
technical_task: Make the audit log read-only for deletion and alteration.
acceptance_criteria: Given an entry in the audit log, when someone tries to delete it, then the deletion is refused.
Given an entry in the audit log, when someone tries to alter it, then the alteration is refused.

requirement_text: Data of the user should be regularly synchronized between their device and the database for auto save functionality.
user_story: As a user, I want my data synchronized regularly between my device and the database, so that auto save works.
technical_task: Synchronize the user's data between the device and the database at regular intervals for auto save.
acceptance_criteria: Given user data on a device, when the synchronization interval elapses, then the data is synchronized with the database.
Given a device that restarts, when the user returns, then the auto-saved data is available.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Regularly" is not quantified.

requirement_text: The HCP can graph height or weight of the patient over the last 3 calendar years .
user_story: As an HCP, I want to graph a patient's height or weight over the last 3 calendar years, so that I can see changes.
technical_task: Plot the patient's height or weight for the last 3 calendar years in a graph.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with height data, when the HCP requests a graph, then height over the last 3 calendar years is shown.
Given a patient with weight data, when the HCP requests a graph, then weight over the last 3 calendar years is shown.

requirement_text: Communication services shall route messages to the proper virtual group(s) and socket.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS052] route messages to the proper virtual group(s) and socket.
user_story: As a software developer, I want communication services to route messages to the proper virtual group or groups and socket, so that messages reach the right place.
technical_task: Direct each message to the right virtual group(s) and socket in communication services.
acceptance_criteria: Given a message for a virtual group and socket, when communication services route it, then it is delivered to that group and socket.
Given a message for several virtual groups, when communication services route it, then it is delivered to each addressed group.

requirement_text: User accessibility must be closely monitored and restricted as needed.
rationale: "Closely monitored" and "as needed" are not defined.
clarification_questions: What does "closely monitored" mean in measurable terms?
Which accessibility and which restrictions are meant?

requirement_text: The solution should support the pharmacist verification of all medications prior to their being dispensed.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should support the pharmacist verification of all  medications prior to their being dispensed.
user_story: As a pharmacist, I want to verify all medications before they are dispensed, so that errors are caught.
technical_task: Require pharmacist verification of every medication before dispensing.
acceptance_criteria: Given a medication that the pharmacist has not verified, when dispensing is attempted, then it is not allowed.
Given a medication verified by the pharmacist, when dispensing is attempted, then it is allowed.

requirement_text: In case of a failure, a re-initialization of program will be done.
user_story: As a user, I want the program re-initialized after a failure, so that it can continue.
technical_task: Re-initialize the program automatically when a failure occurs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failure, when it occurs, then the program is re-initialized.
Given the program has re-initialized, when the user continues, then the program is running again.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to retrieve each item of structured health care information discretely within patient context.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to retrieve each item of structured health care information discretely within the patient context, so that I see exactly the data I need.
technical_task: Allow each structured health care information item to be retrieved individually within the context of a patient.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient and a structured health care information item, when the clinician requests it, then that item is retrieved by itself.
Given a different patient, when the clinician requests the item, then it is retrieved only for the chosen patient.

requirement_text: Each conference room reservation in the system will contain the same information as was entered by the user.
user_story: As an employee, I want each conference room reservation to contain exactly what I entered, so that nothing is changed.
technical_task: Store each conference room reservation with the same information that the user entered.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user enters reservation information, when the reservation is saved, then it contains the same information.
Given a saved reservation, when it is displayed, then it shows the information as entered.

requirement_text: The application shall be able to notify the user when an assignment is close to its due date.
user_story: As a student, I want to be notified when an assignment is close to its due date, so that I don't miss it.
technical_task: Send a notification as an assignment's due date approaches.
acceptance_criteria: Given an assignment with a due date, when it is close to the due date, then the user is notified.
Given an assignment that is not close to its due date, when the user uses the application, then no due-date notification is sent.
rationale: Role assumed: student. "Close" is not defined.

requirement_text: System shall support a variety of media file and text-based formats.
rationale: "A variety of formats" are not named.
clarification_questions: Which media file and text-based formats must be supported?
Is there a minimum list of formats?

requirement_text: Database backup and multiple admin setup with file access privileges shall be available.
user_story: As an administrator, I want database backup and several admins with file access privileges, so that data is protected and work is shared.
technical_task: Provide database backup and the ability to set up multiple administrators with file access privileges.
acceptance_criteria: Given the database, when a backup is run, then the backup is created.
Given several administrators, when they are set up, then each has file access privileges.

requirement_text: Flight hardware shall be fabricated using radiation-hardened and/or radiation tolerant components.
requirement_text_raw: Flight hardware shall (3.2.3.1.2.13) be fabricated using radiation-hardened and/or radiation tolerant components.
user_story: As a mission engineer, I want flight hardware built from radiation-hardened and/or radiation tolerant components, so that it survives the radiation environment.
technical_task: Use radiation-hardened and/or radiation tolerant components in the flight hardware.
acceptance_criteria: Given the flight hardware, when its components are reviewed, then each is radiation-hardened or radiation tolerant.
Given a component that is neither, when it is found in the flight hardware, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: For details of the audio management in the telematics system and the component, see the specification `` System Specification BR342 HU High Audio Handling '' .
requirement_text_raw: For details of the audio management in the telematics system and the component, see the specification `` System Specification BR342 HU High Audio Handling '' [RD2381].
rationale: The sentence only points to another specification.
clarification_questions: What does the referenced specification require for audio management?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: The scoreboard syndromes shall be located in the third longword of the input information block buffer cell.
requirement_text_raw: The scoreboard syndromes shall (3.2.2.6.5) be located in the third longword of the input information block buffer cell.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the scoreboard syndromes located in the third longword of the input information block buffer cell, so that they are found at a fixed place.
technical_task: Place the scoreboard syndromes in the third longword of the input information block buffer cell.
acceptance_criteria: Given an input information block buffer cell, when it is read, then the scoreboard syndromes are in its third longword.
Given an input information block buffer cell, when another longword is read, then it does not hold the scoreboard syndromes.

requirement_text: The streaming server will have anti-virus software to prevent infection of malicious viruses.
requirement_text_raw: The streaming server will have anti-virus software to prevent infection of malicious viruses.'
user_story: As an administrator, I want anti-virus software on the streaming server, so that it is not infected by malicious viruses.
technical_task: Install anti-virus software on the streaming server.
acceptance_criteria: Given the streaming server, when its software is reviewed, then anti-virus software is installed.
Given a malicious virus, when it reaches the streaming server, then the anti-virus software detects it.

requirement_text: A surface computer must not dismiss an engaged menu unless the customer requests it.
requirement_text_raw: A surface computer must not dismiss an engaged menu unless the customer  requests it.
user_story: As a customer, I want an engaged menu not to disappear unless I ask for it, so that I can finish what I'm doing.
technical_task: Keep an engaged menu open on the surface computer until the customer requests that it be dismissed.
acceptance_criteria: Given an engaged menu, when the customer has not requested dismissal, then the menu stays open.
Given an engaged menu, when the customer requests dismissal, then the menu is dismissed.
